The plate spans about 330 px, so at roughly 26 cm that works out to about 0.079 cm per px. The sausage-like item is about 55 px wide (≈4.3 cm) and about 180 px long (≈14 cm). That is a large sausage or a bread roll, though it looks like a sausage or a small sweet potato.

Treating it as a cylinder with a 4 cm diameter and 14 cm length, the volume is π × 4 × 14 ≈ 176 cm³ (π × r² × L = 3.14 × 4 × 14). At a density of about 0.9, that gives roughly 150 g.

If it is a sausage, 150 g comes to about 400 kcal at roughly 2.7 kcal/g. If it is a sweet potato, it would be much lower, at around 130 kcal. The color and the crease suggest a sausage, possibly a pork sausage.

I'll settle on about 130 g and 330 kcal.
